literal_meaning: ঝরে পড়া বা খসে যাওয়ার শব্দানুকরণ (rustling and falling apart)
figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, no hope for improvement; completely ruined
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবন এখন ঝরঝরে হয়ে গেছে।
এই বাড়িটা ঝরঝরে, আর টিকবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His life has become a complete ruin now.
This house is falling apart; it won't last.
note: Idiom often used in sarcastic contexts to denote irreversible decay, possibly evoking imagery of dry leaves falling in rural settings.
